registers.label: Spare
lines: Here is my servant, whom I uphold.
A bruised reed he will not break.
Mary breaks the jar; the house fills with fragrance.
She has kept it for the day of his burial.
In your light, O God, we see light.
Your love reaches to the heavens.
Come, let us pour out our worship.
We follow the servant to the cross. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: The scent of costly nard still hangs in the room where Mary knelt and poured it over his feet.
We follow the servant to the cross.
A whole year's wages spilled in one extravagant act, and the fragrance filled the house.
We follow the servant to the cross.
Here is God's servant: a bruised reed he will not break, a dimly burning wick he will not quench.
We follow the servant to the cross.
In his light we see light; from the fountain of his life we drink.
We follow the servant to the cross.
So pour out what is precious; the day of his burial draws near.
We follow the servant to the cross. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid

Here is the servant of God.
